questions.subject: ALGEBRA_I
questions.learningObjective: Evaluate a rational exponent as a root of the base.
questions.stem: A field biologist's survey counts 4^(1/2) seedlings per quadrat as a density estimate. What value does that estimate equal?
questions.explanation: An exponent of one half means a square root, so 4^(1/2) is 2, the square root of 4. Dividing 4 by 2 happens to land on 2 here, but 9^(1/2) would then wrongly give 4.5 instead of 3.
